name: v0.7.0
body:
## New scan tools

- **Burp Suite Pro**: ingest Burp Issues XML exports directly. Auto-detected from the root `<issues>` element and `burpVersion` attribute. Use the Mapping page to link Burp issue types to your Ghostwriter Web templates on first encounter.
- **Nuclei (ProjectDiscovery)**: ingest Nuclei JSONL output. Auto-detected. Per-host consolidation collapses duplicate hits across templates.

## Findings page rework

- Unmapped section now sits at the top of the page (was below Mapped). The Mapped + Detail row stays alongside each other down to narrower viewports.
- New filter bar on the Unmapped list: filter by framework, by severity, and by title text. Composes AND across categories, OR within an axis.
- Sortable columns on the Unmapped list: click the Title, Type, or Severity headers to sort.
- Severity badges no longer truncate to three characters ("Critical" was rendering as "Cri", "Informational" as "Inf").

## Bug fixes

- Burp findings no longer vanish from the Findings tab. The internal pass/fail flag was being read from the severity field instead of hardcoded to "fail", so every Burp result ended up classified as Informational and filtered out by the Findings filter.
- Burp extension-reported and operator-created issues no longer all collapse into one bucket. On a real 372-issue export, 341 such issues previously folded into 2 buckets, losing 14 distinct vulnerabilities. They now disambiguate by issue name.
- Mapping page's Unmapped panel actually filters out findings that are already mapped (was showing everything).
- Mapping page now consults YAML mappings alongside the local cache when deciding if a finding is mapped. Cache-only checks missed mappings shipped in built-in YAML configs.
- Ingest detail popup reopens correctly after navigating away and back. Previously the popup would silently fail to reopen because the floating-window component held a reference to a DOM node that HTMX had replaced.

## UI improvements

- Finding detail can now be opened in a draggable floating window. Drag by the title bar, roll up by clicking outside it, multiple windows stay open at once.
- "Evidence" renamed to "Description" on the finding detail view. Now surfaces the real per-occurrence evidence instead of a generic blob.
- SARIF and Generic CSV got proper logo icons on the dashboard (were letter badges).
- Splash screen fades in over 1.5 seconds instead of popping into view.
- Mapping page aggregates source IDs from every scan file in your results folder, not just the currently-loaded scan. The Mapping page is meant to be a pan-report dashboard.
- Removed a stale "Coming soon" label from the Templates settings card. The feature it referred to shipped in April; the badge was outdated.
